title: Check the bricks mapping against its first release

acceptance: Waits on bricks' first release (voidbrain/bricks has no release or records on 2026-11-25); once bricks has records, the release step is added to dependsOn as bricks:<STEP-ID>
docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md has a table: each client piece, its bricks token, component or pattern (by exported name), or Grover-only with the reason

privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.

A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: the inventory is already in the record; read bricks' exports and write one table. Not a measurement.
